title: Playing Dice with the Universe: Programming Quantum Computers to Play Traditional Games
summary: The challenge of programming classical computers to play traditional, competitive games against human players has helped to advance classical hardware and software. Quantum computers have the potential to play games in a unique way: programmed \textit{only} with the rules of a game, they should be able to implicitly represent all future paths of a game leading to wins, losses, or draws, and to sample from this path set to identify moves that maximize the likelihood of a win.
